name: Central Square Beach
evidence: Pin (38.151, 20.776) is Poros town, Kefalonia. Poros main beach (NE of town) is semi-organized with sunbed/parasol sets (Greeka, JustKefalonia), but 'Central Square Beach' appears to be the informal strip at the town centre and no source describes that specific strip; cannot attribute the main-beach sunbeds to it.

name: Αθέρας
evidence: Pin matches Porto Atheras, Paliki, Kefalonia. Multiple beach-specific guides agree: 'no sunbeds or parasols to rent are available... two seasonal tavernas'; 'the beach is not organized... bring your own umbrella'; small changing hut only, restrooms at the tavernas (nomadekefalonia, Greeka, kefaloniabyanna).

name: Βραχινάρι
evidence: Pin = end of Vatsa Bay, Paliki. Only source (1001beach, round 1) describes a quiet cozy sandy beach with fenced turtle nests and mentions no sunbeds or bar; no explicit 'unorganized' statement and no second source found, so left unresolved.

name: Καραβόμυλος
evidence: Pin matches Karavomilos village beach at Sami. Kefaloniaguide's page for this exact beach (main beach of Sami, next to the lake mill) says visitors can use provided sun loungers and umbrellas; the beachfront Ionian Emerald resort area also keeps loungers/umbrellas on the beach. No distinct beach bar confirmed.

name: Παραλία Αγία Βαρβάρα
evidence: Pin matches Agia Varvara, the main Katelios beach. Beach-specific sources (WonderGreece Katelios–Agia Varvara, kefaloniabyanna, kefalonia.ws) say sunbeds/umbrellas are available for hire on the main section — often taverna-run — while the far turtle-nesting section past the stream is undeveloped. Partly organized overall; sunbeds confirmed, no standalone beach bar.

name: Λιθοβάτης
evidence: No source describing Lithovatis (near Agia Efimia, Kefalonia) was found in either round; our own data already says 'χωρίς παροχές πάνω στην ακτή' but no external confirmation either way.

name: Νότια Παραλία Νικιάνας
evidence: Pin (38.758, 20.721) = southern stretch of Nikiana towards Episkopos, Lefkada. amazinglefkada: 'just about enough room for one row of sunbeds along most of the beach, belonging to the hotels behind' plus a beach cantina renting sunbeds/umbrellas; the adjacent Episkopos-Nikiana beach immediately south is well organized with sunbed pairs and a beach bar (Greeka). Sunbeds present on the south stretch; dedicated beach bar not confirmed for this exact strip.

name: Αμπελάκια
evidence: No source specific to Ampelakia on Meganisi found (name collides with Peloponnese/Salamina beaches); Meganisi guides state only Fanari is fully organized on the island, which casts doubt on our claimed showers/changing rooms/WC, but there is no explicit statement about this cove.

name: Μικρή Ξύγκια
evidence: Disambiguated as Xigia 'Dipla', the small cove next to main Xigia (Zakynthos). rezante/ecozante: 'usually only a few umbrellas and sunbeds, so best take your own'; 'no beach bars, canteens or much civilization' at the cove (canteen is at main Xigia). Sparse/seasonal sunbeds too unreliable to claim organized; no bar confirmed negative.

name: Μαδράκια
evidence: Pin matches Madrakia by the port of Agios Nikolaos (Volimes), Zakynthos. Beach-specific pages (Greeka Madrakia, beaches-searcher) describe the small sandy stretch by the family-run Madrakia Taverna with 'basic amenities, such as deckchairs & umbrellas, beach bars, toilets'. Sunbeds confirmed; food is the shoreline taverna.

name: Βουρδέρη
evidence: Pin matches Vourderi in Vasilikos, Zakynthos. The local Vasilikos guide's page for this exact beach: 'Along the beach there are many beach bars, sun beds and umbrellas', contrasted with nearby beaches that have none; Celia Apartments sits above this beach confirming the locality.

name: Παραλία Δεξά
evidence: Dexa/Dexia near Vathy, Ithaca (pin matches). Multiple beach-specific sources (ithacorama, Greeka, Tripadvisor reviews): sunbeds/umbrellas for rent in peak season (~10 EUR per pair), small canteen/bar serving drinks and snacks, lifeguard in season, plus natural olive-tree shade. Resolves the round-1 'canteen only' doubt.

name: Κατσούνι
evidence: Disambiguated to Psara (pin at the settlement's east side; Rhodes/Anafi namesakes excluded). Psara-specific pages (WonderGreece Psara Katsouni, greecevacationsearch Psara entry) describe it as the island's most popular sandy beach with sunbeds, WC and parking, hosting summer beach-volley tournaments. No beach bar confirmed.

name: Φύτεμα
evidence: Fytema near Evdilos, Ikaria: only evidence is the Popi taverna at Fytema (food nearby confirmed); Ikaria organized-beach lists (Mesakti, Livadi, Kampos, Gialiskari) never include Fytema, but no source states sunbeds present or absent for this beach.

name: Αυλάκι
evidence: Pin (38.967, 26.438) is the Kratigos/Haramida area south of Mytilene. All 'Avlaki' hits are namesakes elsewhere (Avlaki Taverna between Petra and Anaxos ~40km away, plus Corfu/Crete/Attica); the Mytilene municipality beach list does not resolve an Avlaki here. Cannot pin the locality, so no verdict.

name: Παραλία Δρότας
evidence: Drota near Plomari, Lesvos (pin matches). The Drota taverna-ouzeri (drota.gr) sits on the beach, but no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas; regional guides group it with the quiet natural Plomari-area beaches. Leaning unorganized-with-taverna but no explicit statement found.

name: Παραλία Καγιά
evidence: Kagia east of Skala Sikamnias, Lesvos (pin matches). 1001beach notes tamarisk shade, showers and changing cabins and the Kagia fish taverna, but no source mentions sunbeds/umbrellas or an explicit unorganized statement; showers suggest some municipal provision only.

name: Τσιχράντα
evidence: Mikri/Megali Tsichranta coves west of Anaxos, Lesvos (pin matches Kechrada area). Visit Lesvos and Yallou describe small idyllic coves 'ideal for isolation and quiet swimming' with parking only; no facility list and no explicit unorganized statement, so unresolved (leans unorganized).

name: Μπάλος
evidence: Balos in Ormos Koumeikon, SW Samos (pin matches; Crete namesake excluded). The official Greek bathing-water profile for this exact beach (GRBW149264276) states a section is organized with umbrellas, loungers, changing rooms and bins; samosin.gr's older 'not organized, tavernas on the road' conflicts but the official beach-specific profile is more authoritative. Tavernas are roadside, no beach bar.

name: Μικρά Λεμονάκια
evidence: All sources describe only the main Lemonakia beach near Kokkari (well organized: sunbeds, umbrellas, seaside taverna). Our pin (37.778, 26.897) sits closer to Kokkari than to main Lemonakia (26.887) and no source distinguishes a 'Mikra Lemonakia' cove, so the organized evidence cannot be safely attributed.

name: Μπούκα
evidence: Pin (37.333, 23.124) is on the Ermionida coast north of Kosta/Porto Heli. All 'Bouka organized' evidence still refers to Bouka in Messinia; nearby organized beaches (Kosta, Hinitsa) are distinct named beaches. No Argolida-Bouka-specific source found in two rounds.

name: Παραλία Βαγιωνία
evidence: Disambiguated: pin (37.641, 23.159) = Vagionia at the right-hand entrance of the harbour of Palaia Epidavros, behind Agios Nikolaos church (Terrabook Argolida) — NOT the organized Vagionia on Poros island. Terrabook: 'χωρίς πολλές ξαπλώστρες, μόνο κάμποσες ψάθινες ομπρέλες, πάνω στο βότσαλο και την άμμο' — a few fixed straw umbrellas only, no sunbeds, no bar/canteen; visitors advised to bring supplies. The round-1 'organized with cafe' claim matched the Poros namesake.

name: Πλαζ Αλκυονίδας
evidence: Pin (38.067, 22.992) is the Schinos/Strava shore of the Alkyonides Gulf, Korinthia. Guides describe Schinos and Strava-Alkyoni as quiet pebble shores but no source names or describes a 'Plaz Alkyonidas' beach with facilities; the round-1 Alepochori evidence is a different beach across the gulf.

name: Σιδερώνα
evidence: Siderona near Korfos, Korinthia (pin matches). Beach-specific Greek sources: 'ανοργάνωτη, ωστόσο υπάρχει ένα ταβερνάκι ακριβώς δίπλα' whose fish taverna 'απλώνει μερικές ομπρέλες και ξαπλώστρες πάνω στην ακροθαλασσιά' — the taverna puts a few umbrellas and sunbeds on the shore. Sunbeds genuinely present (taverna-run, limited); no beach bar.

name: Αρτάνη
evidence: Artani near Archangelos/Plytra, Lakonia: after two rounds only a Facebook page exists; no travel guide, concession decision or review describing facilities was found.

name: Βιανδίνη (Βούρκος)
evidence: Small pebble beach just south of Elia, Lakonia (pin matches). Only an aggregator entry ('small pebbly beach ~0.23km') with no facility information; no sunbed/bar evidence in either direction.

name: Λιμάνι
evidence: Limani at Elia, Monemvasia municipality (pin matches). The beach itself is a narrow 4-5m sand strip with no facilities; bathers use the harbour mole where sunbeds are placed ('στον λιμενοβραχίονα... υπάρχουν ξαπλώστρες'), framed by cafe-restaurants. Sunbeds exist adjacent on the jetty, not on the beach — too ambiguous to claim the beach organized.
